snippet.title: Teaser Game - Pawsome Resort
snippet.description:
Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim with Co-op gameplay where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.

Credit: PixelPuffs
